selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: Why does the passage say it will speak only about two dangers to strong faith in this time?
questions.answer: Because the truth has already been clearly proved elsewhere, so this part only points out two big causes of doubt.

questions.question: What does it choose to explain in this section?
questions.answer: It explains two deep causes of doubt that weaken certainty of faith.

questions.question: In the first matter, what happens when proof and denial face each other?
questions.answer: Proof stands firm, while denial remains weak.

questions.question: In that example, whose statement carries weight: the few who saw it or the many who did not?
questions.answer: The few who saw it carry weight because they have proof.

questions.question: What causes agreement when people affirm something?
questions.answer: They are all confirming the same reality.

questions.question: What makes proving existence easier than proving total non-existence?
questions.answer: Existence can be shown by one clear sign, but non-existence needs complete checking everywhere.

questions.question: What mistake do deniers make when judging big matters?
questions.answer: They judge by their own selves, minds, and eyesight instead of the reality itself.

questions.question: Why is denial of existence everywhere almost impossible to establish?
questions.answer: Because the whole world and even past times would have to be checked.

questions.question: Why is the second statement too big for a person to make?
questions.answer: Because it claims complete knowledge that a person does not have.

questions.question: What does it teach about the structure of negation?
questions.answer: It becomes multiple because each person adds his own separate viewpoint.

questions.question: What does the passage choose to explain instead of repeating all the proof for the truth?
questions.answer: It explains two major causes that disturb certainty of faith in this age.

questions.question: What is this section trying to address for readers living in this age?
questions.answer: It is addressing two serious sources of hesitation in faith.

questions.question: What is the central teaching of the first matter?
questions.answer: Denial cannot stand strong against real proof.

questions.question: Why does confirmation lead to agreement?
questions.answer: Because each confirming person adds support to the same truth.

questions.question: Why can affirming witnesses stand together?
questions.answer: Because they are testifying to the same thing that really exists.

questions.question: Why do several denials not become strong in the same way?
questions.answer: Because each denial is separate and based on that person’s own lack of sight or knowledge.

questions.question: Why would proving non-existence everywhere be extremely hard?
questions.answer: Because it would require a complete search through the whole world and all times.

questions.question: According to the passage, from where do deniers often make their judgments?
questions.answer: From their own souls, intelligence, and vision.

questions.question: What conclusion should a believer draw from this about the majority of deniers?
questions.answer: Their large numbers do not give them real proof or lasting strength.

questions.question: What does the passage say has already been established with strong evidence?
questions.answer: The main truth about faith has already been firmly shown.

questions.question: How many matters are given as a way to be saved from the first abyss?
questions.answer: Two matters are given.

questions.question: What does the first matter teach about saying “no” to a proven truth?
questions.answer: That such denial is very weak.

questions.question: Why do people who deny something not truly support one another in the same way?
questions.answer: Because each one is only speaking from his own limited view and stays separate from the others.

questions.question: What example is used to show this point about proof and denial?
questions.answer: The example of seeing the new moon at the start of Ramadan.
